answer_prose: Recovery in the next 5 km was uncommon under this definition: 5.8% after a first qualifying patch at 20–25 km, and 1.6% after one at 30–35 km. A qualifying patch was more than 10% slower than both the preceding section and the early baseline.
detail_prose: Recovery is assessed after the first qualifying patch; the patch is not selected because recovery later occurred.
